title: Place of business / elevator dreams
content: I read a thread in HighStrangeness about recurring dreams about Malls and places of commerce, and followed the link here. I'm an older guy, 60, and have had two distinct recurring dreams throughout my life. Will create a separate post for each - 1) Elevators in a tall place of business 2) Malls This is long: 1) Had this dream for over 10 years. Would have it at least once a week, sometimes several nights in a row. It has since stopped. The dream centers around elevators and is about trying to get to a specific floor, and having to find the correct elevator. There are apparently several elevators that go to different floors, none are marked correctly, they don't stop at every floor, choosing different floors with no rhyme or reason, and when buttons are pressed, they light up, the elevator ignores them and goes to a different floor. Also, the elevator will shunt sideways and on an angle with a jolt, as it follows a different path up or down, almost like a vertical subway train. The elevators are huge, like over sized service elevators with interiors about 40 feet wide and long. And about 20 feet high. They are in very poor state of repair, the doors are usually off kilter, and hanging precariously, and I can see the dark walls of the elevator shaft whizzing past as it moves along. I'm usually very stressed in the dream, trying to get to a specific floor for an unknown purpose. And late. It's a business office tower, and there is some type of business to be completed. There are no markings on the elevator to show its car number, or exactly which floor I'm on. It's usually late after hours, I'm under pressure to get to a specific floor, and have no idea where I'm going. There can be others waiting for the elevator, and they are usually just as frustrated as I am that the elevator will come up past our floor without stopping, leaving us waiting for the next one. When an elevator arrives, it's dingy, dark, in poor condition, very much dangerous, with the doors loose, and it's huge. I stand by the edge of the door, and see the large panel of buttons. Pressing one makes it light up, a dim orange color. The button panel has several columns of floor buttons to choose from. The frustration begins in the hallway, trying to get the elevator to stop at the floor. They pass by either up or down, and ignore the pressed button in the hallway. I'm usually alone, but sometimes there are other people there waiting too. When an elevator finally does stop, the doors open and some how I know I want to get to say, floor 57. There may not be a floor 57 button on the panel. It may be all 10s, 20s, 30s, 60s and 70s. So, since the doors closed, I ride it upward and plan to get off at the next floor and take another elevator that will go to the 57th. The elevator stops, the doors open, nearly falling off the track, and it's usually far from the edge where I have to jump a few feet to reach the floor, or too high or low. Once outside on "whatever floor I'm on" I start to look for another elevator - there's usually a couple other ones in the row, and I press the call button. Waiting. Late. Frustrated. Elevator arrives. Get in, some buttons on panel are already pressed, I find my button which can change in the dream to whatever now, and I press something, only to find the doors won't close fully on my side of the huge elevator, so I have to go to the other side of the 40 foot interior, where there is, strangely enough, another set of doors on that side that had opened, and the others got out, but I just didn't make it in time, and it closes with just me inside, and i start going either up, down, or sideways to god only knows what floor, and I'm stressed and in there by myself, with no idea where I need to go, which floor I'm on, and which elevator is the correct one to get me there. If I do make it to an office, it's one that I've worked in before, and have my own desk. I get paper and stuff from other people's desk, and do some type of work, moving papers from one desk to another, walking around, quite comfortable in the work place, as I've worked in that unknown office for a long time. No idea what it is. I just seem to move things from one desk to another, and then have to take an elevator somewhere at some point. And the whole thing starts over in another dream another night. Whew... the recurring dream is just variations on that. Rickety huge elevator, doors falling off, not stopping when it should, can't work the thing to get where I want, lost, late, angry. Work at some place with lots of desks, moving paper around and feeling quite accomplished at it. LOL. Had that recurring dream for over 10 years.
